entities.title: Friends and History only for a signed-in player
entities.summary: The top bar shows Friends and History only when someone is signed in; signed out, Sign in and Play a friend lead to sign-in.
entities.context: Signed out there are no friends, and the history is only the device's games against the computer.
entities.decision: Hide Friends and History while signed out; the signed-out history stays, but is no longer reachable from the bar.
